text:
mira: Heads up — noticed a token-count gap for invoices processed between 2026-03-18T02:00Z and 2026-03-18T06:00Z. ~120 customers affected. We applied a containment rule to stop double-counting but need fixes + compensations. tagging owners & timeline please.
samir: quick summary from infra: Kafka consumer lag + a new dedupe edge-case in the metering worker caused duplicate emit of token events during a rebalance. root cause confirmed, will post RC shortly.
leo: working on backfill job to recompute net tokens for the window. ETA 8h if no surprises. will run in dry-run mode first against staging.
anya: from billing ops POV we should: 1) provisional credit for impacted invoices, 2) queue one-off invoice corrections after backfill, 3) customer comms template. I can own credits + comms.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-4721 created: "Token duplicate spike — containment & compensation" (assignees: samir, leo, anya). Priority: P1. Linked to incident INC-2026-0318.
oncall-ops: deployed temporary rate-limiter to the metering API at 02:15Z which prevented additional duplicates. Hotfix for dedupe check queued for canary tonight.
mira: proposed action items: - Contain (done) — mira confirmed limiter. - Fix dedupe logic and roll out canary — owner: samir — due: 2026-03-18T23:00Z. - Backfill job + dry run — owner: leo — due: 2026-03-19T08:00Z. - Apply provisional credits (manual) — owner: anya — due: 2026-03-18T14:00Z. - One-off invoice corrections after backfill — owner: anya + finance team — due: 2026-03-19T18:00Z. - Postmortem writeup and recurrence mitigation (alert + consumer monitoring) — owner: mira — due: 2026-03-22. Please confirm owners or reassign.
samir: can confirm I'll push the dedupe fix. plan: add stronger idempotency using (event_id, seq) check + unit tests. Canary in eu-west-1 then global.
leo: dry-run logs show 118 affected cust IDs in staging run (matches prod estimates). sample command for run: ```./backfill --start 2026-03-18T02:00Z --end 2026-03-18T06:00Z --dry-run --output staging-dryrun-0318.log``` will share output link after completion.
anya: i'll prepare the credit ledger entries and draft customer email. suggestion: apply provisional credit equal to the overcounted tokens * rate, and hold invoice correction until backfill confirms final numbers.
mira: note on recurrence: pattern looks like consumer rebalance every ~24h spikes under load when autoscaler spins up. we need monitoring: consumer-lag > X AND rebalance-count > Y -> alert. adding to PM doc.
oncall-ops: canary schedule: 2026-03-18T20:00Z eu-west-1, 2026-03-18T22:00Z global (rollouts will be staged). will monitor latency/consumer-lag during roll.
samir: tagging test owners: qa-metering (please prioritize the idempotency tests).
leo: after dry-run I'll post a short CSV with (customer_id, affected_tokens, prev_tokens, corrected_tokens) for finance import.
anya: ack, will wait for CSV before applying credits. also will draft the FAQ for support.
mira: timeline accepted by owners in thread. I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. please update FIN-4721 with any status changes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
